verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Spline exports scenes as code (Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js), self-hosted ZIP bundles, and viewer embeds, but nowhere documents raster/vector asset export (PNG, SVG, PDF) with per-layer presets, scales, or slices — the workflow this story describes. Since Spline is a design tool where such export presets are a plausible feature, this is an applicable-but-unevidenced axis rather than a category error.
